hero.title: Profit & loss overview
hero.text: Financial-year figures for the periods supported by the documents provided.

notes: FY 2017–18: Profit for the year ₹1,56,232; revenue from operations ₹39,26,629; audited statements supplied.
FY 2018–19: Profit for the year ₹36,11,891; revenue from operations ₹24,02,82,696; audited statements supplied.
FY 2019–20: Profit for the year ₹45,11,234; revenue from operations ₹30,43,53,960; source document is marked provisional.

FY 2024–25: Profit and loss account shows a loss of ₹63,26,195. The tax computation also reports a business/profession loss of ₹62,49,405, while the ITR acknowledgement reports a current-year business loss of ₹63,47,851. These measures have not been reconciled.
FY 2025–26: Figures will be added once the records are available.
disclaimer: FY 2024–25 turnover is taken from the GST turnover detail. The loss is the “Profit as per Profit and Loss a/c” figure in the tax computation; it is not an audited annual statement figure.
